why: The verdict is INSTALL WITH CHANGES. Of 33 units, 26 are kept as skills and 7 are dropped; none duplicate the reader's rules. The plugin is almost all its own queue, herd and capture mechanics, so most of it is neutral to the reader's rules. Two conflicts matter, both hard stops. The reviewer role in skills/herd/roles/reviewer.md (Limits) says it "may try the same action, on your own judgement" after a refusal, and the worker role in skills/herd/roles/worker.md says the reviewer may retry an action reported as refused. Both cut against the reader's first safety rule, which bars anything destructive without an explicit go-ahead in the conversation, so a refused delete or force-push could be retried on the agent's own say-so. Two general rules are worth keeping: the reviewer's "Cite every claim you accept with a file:line and a quoted span" (the starred one), and the worker's "Report what you observed, never the verdict". The seven dropped units are the herder skill's own persona and handoff text, which add nothing the reader needs.
do_this: Install the plugin only if you want the queue and herd workflow, and fix the two conflicting passages first: in skills/herd/roles/reviewer.md under Limits and in skills/herd/roles/worker.md, remove the sentences that let the reviewer retry a refused action on its own judgement.
Where a retry is kept, require your explicit go-ahead in the conversation for any destructive or published-history action, as rules/safety.md already says.
Skip the herder skill (skills/herder/SKILL.md): its seven units are dropped.
Keep the other 26 skill units as they come with the plugin; they need no rule changes.
Copy the two new standing rules from the patch below into your engineering rules, so they hold even when the plugin is off.
Re-run the vet after editing the plugin's role files to confirm the two conflicts are gone.
patch:
Add both rules to the end of the numbered list in examples/reader/rules/engineering.md. They fit its style of a bold lead sentence followed by one line of detail. No change is needed in examples/reader/rules/safety.md; the conflicts are fixed in the plugin, not in the reader's hard stops.

```diff
--- a/examples/reader/rules/engineering.md
+++ b/examples/reader/rules/engineering.md
@@
 7. **Commit messages:** imperative subject under 60 characters, then why.
+8. **Cite what you accept.** A reviewer cites every claim it accepts with a
+   file:line and a quoted span. A criterion asserted without a citation is
+   not met.
+9. **Report observations, not verdicts.** Done notes paste the exact commands,
+   exit codes and error text. Never paraphrase evidence.
```
